submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole is a retrospective detector for tokens from the formal/learned or non-English European stratum of the vocabulary: split-off Latin-derived suffix morphemes (-ify/-ifies/-ified/-ification/-ication/-icating/-ization/-ician/-ian/-iano and kin), continental-European personal and place names (Madrid, Kafka, quotidiano), and formal Latinate stems shared across European languages (filter, manager, motivate, interpret). It stays near zero on everyday Germanic-core words, Anglophone names, function words and digits, and on merged whole-word forms (purified, indicating) of the same morphemes that fire when split off.
